data.narrative: Module 8 added owner-scoped GET /links/search with a page_size cap of 50 and allowlisted sort. DB-native FTS SQL is parameterized; runtime stayed in-memory because Postgres is down. BREAK used offset=page*page_size so the first page was empty; FIX restored (page-1)*page_size and boundary tests.
